assumptions: road runs roughly bottom-to-top on the right side of the image with crosswalk across it in the upper third
cars travel from bottom of image toward top, lead vehicle front facing top and stopped at crosswalk edge
stop line placed at southern/downstream edge of crosswalk parallel to crosswalk edge across both traffic lanes
line endpoints at left and right edges of the trafficked lanes to cover full width
waiting zone is the lane area immediately south of the line on the approach side, touching the line along its full length and extending ~2 car lengths upstream to capture queuing cars
raw_output.line_description: stop line at the edge of the crosswalk across the traffic lanes
raw_output.travel_direction: moving upward from the bottom of the image toward the top across the line
raw_output.zone_description: waiting area in the traffic lanes immediately before the stop line where cars queue before the crosswalk
